levels.name: 分子与细胞
levels.emerges: 结构、催化、拥挤中的秩序

levels.name: 文明
levels.emerges_en: language, institutions, the lifespan of ideas

levels.name: 纵线：同一件事穿过所有层
levels.intro: 主干和横线之外的第三种：挑一个具体的事件，让它从最底层一路走到最高层，或者从最高层一路落到最底层，或者绕一圈回到出发的地方；也可以反过来固定尺度、拉动时间。每一层只做最简单的一版，要检验的是层与层之间接不接得上。
levels.name_en: Verticals: one event through every level
levels.intro_en: A third kind besides the trunk and the threads: take one concrete event and follow it from the lowest level to the highest, or from the highest down to the lowest, or round in a loop back to where it began; or the other way, fix the scale and stretch time. Each level gets only its simplest version. What is tested is whether the levels connect.

levels.name: 支线 造：人造的东西
levels.intro: 从零件到会学的机器。前面几条是"人写的规则怎么长出人没写的行为"，后面几条是"造出来的东西开始自己学"。
levels.intro_en: From parts to machines that learn. The first few are about how rules written by people grow behaviour nobody wrote; the last few are about made things starting to learn on their own.

levels.name: 支线 规：纯粹的规则世界
levels.intro: 从所有规则的全貌，到规则里长出的东西，再到规则更底下的东西。这条支线没有现实数据可以对齐，它的对齐对象是数学上已经证明的事实，和主干上那些现象的"形状"。
levels.name_en: Branch 规: worlds of pure rules
levels.intro_en: From the whole space of rules, to what grows inside rules, to what lies underneath rules. This branch has no real-world data to align with; it aligns with facts already proven in mathematics, and with the shapes of the phenomena on the trunk.

threads.name: 传播
threads.desc: 一个东西从一个单位传给下一个。电波在心肌里 → 病毒在细胞间 → 谣言在人群里 → 观念在世代间
threads.desc_en: Something passes from one unit to the next. A wave in heart muscle → a virus between cells → a rumour in a crowd → an idea across generations

threads.name: 临界与崩溃
threads.desc: 平时没事，突然全局垮掉。相变 → 沙堆 → 心脏乱颤 → 挤兑 → 王朝覆灭
threads.desc_en: Nothing happens for a long time, then everything gives way at once. Phase transition → sandpile → a fibrillating heart → a bank run → the fall of a dynasty

threads.name: 互猜的深度
threads.desc: "我知道你知道"。两人 → 谈判 → 三人 → 谎言网 → 大家都收所以我也收的"钱"
threads.desc_en: "I know that you know." Two people → a negotiation → three people → a web of lies → money that I accept because everyone accepts it

threads.name: 记忆
threads.desc: 过去怎么留在现在。免疫记忆 → 神经记忆 → 记仇与原谅 → 传抄与误读
threads.desc_en: How the past stays in the present. Immune memory → neural memory → grudges and forgiveness → copying and misreading

threads.name: 层与层的接口
threads.desc: 下一层的一群怎么变成上一层的一个。粒子→流体，细胞→身体，神经元→念头，交换→货币
threads.desc_en: How a crowd on one level becomes a single thing on the next. Particles → fluid, cells → body, neurons → thought, exchange → money

kernels.name: 存量与流量
kernels.desc: 几个量互相流入流出，带反馈和延迟
kernels.desc_en: A few quantities flowing into and out of each other, with feedback and delay

kernels.name: 递归互猜
kernels.desc: 每个人脑子里装着对方的脑子，一层套一层
kernels.desc_en: Each mind holds a model of the other mind, nested level upon level

kernels.name: 重复相处与约定
kernels.desc: 同样的人反复打交道，记得过去，慢慢形成默契或规矩
kernels.desc_en: The same people deal with each other again and again, remember the past, and settle into habits or rules

kernels.name: 学习的个体
kernels.desc: 一个会感知、会记、会从结果里学的单个主体
kernels.desc_en: A single agent that perceives, remembers and learns from outcomes

kernels.name: 网络上的传播
kernels.desc: 一样东西沿着人和人的关系传开，边传边变
kernels.desc_en: Something spreads along the ties between people and changes as it goes

kernels.name: 阈值与级联
kernels.desc: 每个单元攒够了就翻转，并推一把邻居
kernels.desc_en: Each unit flips once enough has built up, and nudges its neighbours

kernels.name: 离散规则的反复应用
kernels.desc: 一组符号，一条改写它的规则，一遍一遍地用
kernels.name_en: Discrete rules applied over and over
kernels.desc_en: A set of symbols and a rule that rewrites them, applied again and again

kernels.name: 粒子
kernels.desc: 很多个点，两两之间有力，按运动定律走
kernels.desc_en: Many points with pairwise forces, moving by the laws of motion

kernels.name: 空间里的个体
kernels.desc: 很多主体在地图上移动，只看身边
kernels.desc_en: Many agents moving on a map, each seeing only what is nearby

kernels.name: 分子的随机反应
kernels.desc: 数得清个数的分子，按概率相遇和反应
kernels.desc_en: Countable molecules that meet and react by chance

kernels.name: 场与形态
kernels.desc: 浓度和形状在空间里扩散、生长
kernels.desc_en: Concentrations and shapes diffusing and growing in space

kernels.name: 代际演化
kernels.desc: 一代代复制、变异、被筛选
kernels.desc_en: Copying, varying and being selected, generation after generation

kernels.name: 连续体力学
kernels.desc: 会变形、会断、会被切开的连续体
kernels.desc_en: A continuous body that deforms, breaks and can be cut
